total_reimbursement.meaning: Total insurance reimbursement across all claims ($)

ip_claim_pct.meaning: Fraction of claims that are inpatient

avg_deductible.meaning: Average deductible amount paid per claim ($)

reimbursement_to_peer_median.meaning: Provider total reimbursement relative to training peer median

repeat_bene_count.meaning: Patients with more than one claim at this provider

repeat_bene_ratio.meaning: Fraction of patients with repeated claims

same_day_repeated_claims.meaning: Count of same-day same-patient repeated claims

missing_physician_ratio.meaning: Fraction of claims with missing attending physician

distinct_physicians.meaning: Number of distinct attending physicians billed

unique_diagnosis_codes.meaning: Distinct diagnosis codes used across all claims

diagnosis_code_entropy.meaning: Shannon entropy of diagnosis code distribution

unique_procedure_codes.meaning: Distinct procedure codes used across all claims

procedure_code_entropy.meaning: Shannon entropy of procedure code distribution

avg_inpatient_length_of_stay.meaning: Average length of stay in days for inpatient claims

claim_date_anomaly_count.meaning: Count of claims with ClaimEndDt < ClaimStartDt

claim_date_anomaly_ratio.meaning: Fraction of claims with ClaimEndDt < ClaimStartDt

discharge_before_admission_count.meaning: Count of inpatient claims with DischargeDt < AdmissionDt

discharge_before_admission_ratio.meaning: Fraction of inpatient claims with DischargeDt < AdmissionDt

avg_beneficiary_age.meaning: Average patient age at actual claim date (years)

avg_chronic_cond_count.meaning: Average number of chronic conditions per patient

renal_disease_ratio.meaning: Fraction of patient-claims with renal disease

deceased_bene_ratio.meaning: Fraction of patient-claims where patient is deceased

claims_after_death_ratio.meaning: Fraction of claims submitted after patient death

claims_after_death_count.meaning: Total claims submitted after patient death

avg_part_a_coverage_months.meaning: Average Part A Medicare coverage months (0-12)

full_part_a_coverage_ratio.meaning: Fraction of claims where patient had full 12-month Part A coverage

avg_part_b_coverage_months.meaning: Average Part B Medicare coverage months (0-12)

full_part_b_coverage_ratio.meaning: Fraction of claims where patient had full 12-month Part B coverage

active_months.meaning: Number of distinct calendar months with at least one claim

avg_monthly_claims.meaning: Average claims per active calendar month

max_monthly_claims.meaning: Peak claims in any single calendar month

avg_monthly_reimbursement.meaning: Average total reimbursement per active month ($)

monthly_spike_ratio.meaning: Peak month to average month claim count ratio

avg_monthly_claim_change.meaning: Mean absolute month-to-month claim count change

avg_days_between_claims.meaning: Average calendar days between consecutive claims
